acceptance.item: A written public API contract (module paths, functions, grammar version, error types) lives in the repository and is generated or checked from the code, not hand-maintained.
A contract test fails when a public name, signature or grammar construct in the contract changes without a version bump and a changelog entry.
The release process produces a tagged version whose number matches the package metadata; the tag and the metadata cannot disagree (check in CI).
acceptance.note: --check-tag verified locally (match exit 0, two mismatches exit 1); the first GitHub Actions run needs push and owner merge

acceptance.item: No simulated or stubbed behaviour is exposed through the contract without an evidence label.
